tei:div.tei:p: 363) dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs he ru ka /gtan gyi skyabs mgon pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// byang chub bar du rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs// bdag rgyud chos dang 'dres par mdzad du gsol// nyon dang sngon smon las 'phro can// yang dag lam la 'jug spro na// mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten// mnyes gsum bsgrub la dgongs spyod slobs// blo ldog bzhi yis rang rgyud sbyongs// blang dor gnas la mkhas par gyis// pha yul srin po'i gling dang mtshungs// byas tshad ngan song 'khor ba'i rgyu// bde med sdug bsngal rin gyis nyo// phud byed dug sbrul tshang lta bur// las 'bras bslu med rang la smin// de phyir 'khor ba'i bya ba la// snying po med pa'i don la sems// rkyen bral yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// mi med dben pa'i ri sul du// snying nas chos shig bsgrub nus na// snying po'i don de mthong lags bsam// rang rig 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// bcos bsgyur blo yis ma byed par// rig stong brjod bral ngang du zhog /mngon gyur chen po lta ba'i gnad/ 364)/chos nyid gting gsal dbus mtha' bral// sku dang ye shes gzhi ru rdzogs// 'bad rtsol spros pa bral ba yi// 'khor 'das chos rnams rig pa'i babs// gsal stong gnyis med ye shes che// sgom 'dzin las 'das sgom pa'i gnad// gang shar spang blang yul las 'das// ye shes chen po'i rol par shar// gzung 'dzin gnyis snang dbyings su nub// ma bcos bzhag pa spyod pa'i gnad// don la rang byung ye shes nyid// blo 'das ye grol chen po la// lta sgom spyod pa'i tshig las 'das// sku gsum mnyam nyid 'od gsal klong*// rang rig mngon gyur 'bras bu'i gnad// de bzhin rgyun du nyams len rem// mi gnas gtan srid tshe 'di ru// zin par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// de skad dad ldan a stag gis// bskul ba zab phyir snyoms las pa// bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes bris/

dge'o// ka dag rig pa zang thal 'di/ kha dog las 'das 'od gsal ngang*// ga ler ma bcos rang babs klong*// ngar 'dzin mdud rgya dbyings su bor// ma bcos ma bsgyur rang byung gi /ye shes chen por nyams blangs na// kun bzang dgongs pa mngon gyur nas/ 365)/rang gnas 'bras bu e ma ho// de skad bla ma skyabs kyi ngor// su kha'i ming gis bris pa'o// dge'o// kun tu bzang dang dbyer med pa'i// 'dren mchog pad+ma las 'brel la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs// bdag rgyud smin grol byin gyis rlobs// e ma gson dang skal ldan lags// rang byung rig pa byang chub sems// spros bral rnam thar gsum dang ldan// sku dang ye shes bdag nyid dpal// 'khor 'das gnyis med 'ub chub klong*// ji bzhin rtogs pa lta ba lags// ma bcos tha mal shes pa 'di// zang thal 'bad rtsol blo bral ngang*// gang snang ye shes chen po'i gshis// rang babs mngon gyur sgom pa lags// gang shar ma bcos gnyug ma'i klong*// spang blang ye zad rtog gnyis bral// yul snang thug phrad rjen par glod// shar cha ye shes lam du khyer// 'dzin zhen rang grol nam mkha' che// ma bcos ngang bzhag spyod pa lags// nang gsal thim la ma rmugs pa'i// ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i bdag /rang byung rig pa chos kyi sku// mi gnas mi 'gyur ye shes ngang*// spang thob bral 366)ba 'bras bu lags// ngo bo gcig la ldog pa'i tshul// lta sgom spyod 'bras lam gnad 'di// bya bral shes rab 'od zer gyis// dbang mdog rin chen skyes bcas ngor// mdo med 'chol mo sprang 'khyams pa// su kha badz+ra rtsal gyis bris/ dge'o// kye ma gson dang shī la badz+ra// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i grong khyer// 'jig lugs 'di la ltos dang*// snga sor yod pa'i dpa' bo// da ni mthong thos tsam med// na ning yod pa'i snying sdug /da lo mi snang yib song*// zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dran tshe// gsal byed chu rgyun 'bebs byung*// gsung gis byams skyong dran dus// 'dug thabs med pa o o// thugs kyi brtse gdung dran dus// 'dir snang bya bas ci byed// dpa' bo nyid dang dbyer med// 'khod pa'i smon lam dran 'dug

/'khor slob gdul bya'i zhing sa// da ni 'dus byas gyur 'dug /tshe gang 'grogs pa'i gtan grogs// da ni tshe sdug song 'dug /chos mthun gzhung bzang bsam pa// da ni sdug sems gang 'dug /ci dang ci la bsam yang*// da ni dgos pa ma byung*// sa ga zla ba 'bod pa'i// dus su mi 367)snang yib bsam// las dbang ngan pa ma zad// da dung yun ring 'dug thang*// a la ku re yin no// snying gi bu mchog khyod dang*// 'bral med lo shas 'dug snyam// yang yang sems la bcag yod// snang srid 'khor 'das chos kun// gnyis med rig par rtogs na// tshad ldan dpa' bo mchog nyid// thag ring zhig la mi snang*// rang byung rig pa de ka /thabs mchog rgyal po los yin// rig stong bde ba chen por// nam yang 'bral ba med do// de skad snying med bu mo// su kha badz+ra rtsal gyis// shī la badz+ra'i drung du// yi mug glu ru drangs nas// yi ge'i ris su phul lo/ dge'o// kye ma kye hud 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos// gang la bsam yang skyo ba skye ba'i rgyu// ci la bsam yang mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos// snga sor gza' tshang tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra// 'dus pa'i mtha' ma bral lugs 'di la ltos// rgyu nor longs spyod rtswa kha'i zil pa 'dra// gsogs pa'i mtha' ma 'dzad lugs 'di la ltos// brtse ba'i snying grogs nam mkha'i 'ja' 368)tshon 'dra// 'grogs pa'i mtha' ma bral lugs 'di la ltos// gces pa'i bu phrug la kha'i na bun 'dra// bskyangs pa'i mtha' ma bral tshul 'di la ltos// dga' ba'i mched grogs dbyar gyi me tog 'dra// 'tshogs pa'i mtha' ma 'thor lugs 'di la ltos// 'u cag ma bu sngon gyis las kyis 'dus// ci yong cha mi chod pa'i dus la ltos// da ni cis kyang 'khor bar snying po med// snying po yod pa dam pa'i lha chos rem// rang rig bla mar rtogs pa'i gdams pa 'di// pha gcig rtogs ldan bla ma'i drin gyis thos// da ni yal bar ma dor nyams len mdzod// mi tshe'i lhag ma snying po'i chos la dril// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i dpal chos sgrubs// bla ma'i sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs// lus snang lha skur smin pa'i gdams pa thob// bla ma'i gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs// 'byin 'jug rlung sngags yi ge'i rol par shar// bla ma'i thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la zhugs// chos nyid don mthong thugs yid gcig dril ngang*// 'khor 'das dag mnyam chen po'i gding zhig thob// de skad dga' skyo 'dres ma'i 'chal gtam 'di// snying med bu mo bde ba'i

369)rdo rje yis// snying gi bu mchog shī la badz+ra la// snying gtam sdug gtam tshul du phul ba'o// dge'o// rje 'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje can// kun mkhyen pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// las ngan bdag la thugs rjes gzigs// ngas bsam zhing bsam na skyo ba skyes// dran zhing dran na mchi ma 'khrugs// sngon las 'phro ldan pas khyed dang mjal// yun ring du thugs kyis brtse bas bskyangs// da las ngan nga lus ngan dman pa yi// pha khyed dang 'grogs pa'i skal ba zhan// gsung zab pa'i gdams pa cher ldan kyang*// bdag blo chung dman pa'i snod ma ldan// grogs brtse ba'i mched grogs kun bzhugs kyang*// rang gcig pur rgyus med sa mthar spyugs// ngo shes pa rtsa shing chu las med// pha drin chen bla ma'i zhal ngo yib// da gdams ngag dpe char re dgos shar// lam ston mkhan bla ma gcig kyang med// rang sems rang gis skyong dgos byung*// snying brtse ba'i nyams myong zhu sa med// sku mi snang gdung 'bod byed dgos byung*// smin grol gyi gdams pa zhu sa med// rang sems bla mar re dgos byung*/ 370)/dngos 'byor gyi mchod pa phul sa med// yid mos pa'i mchod pa 'bul dgos byung*// zhal dkyil 'khor mjal ba'i skal ba med// 'jim sangs rgyas spyan mar re dgos byung*// sku gzi brjid ldan pa mthong reg bral// yid mun sgom rmi lam re dgos 'byung*/ gsung byams pa'i bdud rtsi zhu sa med// zhal rgyun gyi dpe cha bri dgos byung*// thugs brtse ba'i dgongs nyams zhu sa med// stong pa gnyis blo yis bzhag dgos byung*// sgo gsum gyi bya ba dri sa med// da rang mgo gar thon byed dgos byung*// zas gang yod dngos su 'bul sa med// phud tsam gyis mchod pa/ bla ma'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes chen po'i stong nyid dang*/ rang gi rig pa bzhi cha gsum bral gyi stong pa'i ye shes gnyis dbyer med du bzhag pa/

'bul dgos byung*// da ci la bsam yang rje nyid dran// gos bzang po yod kyang 'bul sa med// tshig snyan po thos kyang zhu sa med// nyams rtogs pa 'char yang zhu sa med// las skyid sdug byung yang 'dri sa med// yid sdug gi non kyang re sa med// las gang la bsam yang sdug bsngal che// da 'chi la rang dbang med nges kyang*// bdag med nga sa mthar 'gro dgos snyam// snying brtse ba'i 371)shī la badz+ra dang*/ khong mched grogs rnams blo yis ma thongs nas// sdug mtha' ded byed dgos bdag la byung*// da bsam zhing bsam na bla ma dran// rje dus gsum sangs rgyas khong rang dran// rje kun bzang pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs mdzod la// bdag deng nas skye ba thams cad du// pha khyed kyis 'bral med rjes bzung nas// gnas dag pa zhing mchog gang yang rung*// rje khyed kyi 'khor gyi thog ma ru// bdag 'dren ston bsu ma ma mdzad na// dus bcu gsum 'brel ba'i dgos pa chung*// da bslu med bden gnyis mthu stobs kyis// pha khyed dang dbyer med 'grub par shog ces pa 'di phyi gnyis sdug bdag lta bu'i las ngan pa 'di la zhe khrel nas yid shin ru skyo ba bzod blag med pa zhig byung skabs snang gsal mthongs nas yi mug yig ris su bris te bdag med bde ba'i rdo rjes shī la badz+ra la phul ba'o// dge'o// kye ma kye hud bdag gi mgon gcig pu/ dus rnams kun tu rjes su ma bzung na/ kho mo bdag 'dra'i las ngan ga la yod// skyabs dang re sa khyed min bdag la med// dus 372)kun rgyun chad med par rje khyod dran// gsal byed dbang sgor chu rgyun chad pa med// 'dir snang 'dug thabs blo gtad bca' sa bral// 'jam 'jam tshig gis 'brid mkhas mang na yang*// dpa' bo khyed 'dra'i grogs mchog shin tu dkon// brtse ba'i tshul gyis gces par bskyangs na yang*// sa lam bgrod pa'i shing rta khyed 'dra dkon// 'byin 'jug rlung gi 'khrul 'khor rtsal ldan yang*// rlung bcur dbang 'byor dpa' bo khyed 'dra dkon// spros bcas bskyed rim cung zad ldan na yang*// a nu'i dgongs bcud mthar phyir khyed 'dra dkon// rten 'brel thabs mkhas thabs grogs mang na yang*// nang don ye shes mngon sum ston mdzad pa// yid bzhin nor bu las lhag khyed lta bu/

kho mo bdag 'dras sngar yang ma rnyed la// phyis kyang khyed 'dra rnyed pa lta ci smos/ khyed kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer rab g.yos pas// bdag gi 'khrul snang btsan thabs nyid du dag /snang grags rig gsum sku gsung thugs su smin// rtsa rlung thig le dkyil 'khor chen por rdzogs// lhun grub sku dang ye shes mngon gyur nas// rang snang don gyi 'og min chen po ru/ bla ma khyed dang skad cig mi 'bral zhing*/ 373)/zung 'jug gzhon nu bum skur sangs rgyas shog ces gsol ba btab mthar 'od mthing gi rnam par mi snang bar gyur/ de ltar sems kyi ri mo sna tshogs pa// dgos med rdzun gtam don 'bras med mod kyang*// snying gi bu mchog shī la badz+ra gyi// mya ngan bsal phyir ma yi gsang tshig rnams// sbas gsang med par gang shar yi ger bris// nged cag thabs shes smon lam 'phro ldan pas// tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med lhan du 'tshogs/ khyod kyang las 'phro bzang po'i stobs shugs dang*// snying gi bu bzhin brtse bas rjes bzung phyir// nam yang 'bral med bla ma yab yum mjal// nges tshig bslu ba med do snying gi bu// yid bzhin nor bu nam mkha'i 'ja' dang 'dra// bu mo nga ni ri rtse'i na bun 'dra// snying gi bu khyod dbyar gyi me tog 'dra// grwa 'khor longs spyod rtswa kha'i zil pa 'dra// tha dad so so'i rnam pa ci 'char yang*// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol pa las ma 'das// thams cad chos dbyings chen po'i ngang du 'dus// tha dad gnyis su 'dzin pa'i yul las 'das// rang byung rig pa don dam bla ma ni// sku gsum mnyam nyid chen po'i ngo bor 374)bzhugs// sgo gsum gcig dril ngang nas gsol ba thobs// thugs yid gcig 'dres dbang bzhi'i dngos grub thob// sangs rgyas gzhan tshol mi dgos dgongs pa lon// de skad bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa dge /rtogs ldan bla ma'i drin gyis// rang rig mngon du gyur tshe// bcos bsgyur blo yis ma bcings// rang babs ngang du skyongs dang*// chos sku'i gtan srid zin nges/
ces pa'ang badz+ra ming gis so//

375) dbang gi rnam bshad ni/ dbang gi ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ thob pa'i phan yon/ ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs dang lnga las/ ngo bo la rgyu gnyis dang rkyen bzhi/ rgyu gnyis ni slob dpon dang slob ma'o/ ye gzhi kun tu bzang po rdo rje slob dpon du shar ba dang*/ rig pa rang byung gi ye shes slob ma'i rgyud la yod pa gnyis kyis rgyu byas/ mchan/ rkyen bzhi ni/ dmigs pa'i rkyen/ bla ma'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi dbyings bzhugs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams spyan drangs nas slob ma'i rgyud la bstim nas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du brlabs nas dag rdzogs smin gsum mthar phyin pa la'o/ rdzas kyi rkyen/ mtshan bcas rten 'brel rdzas la brten nas/ mtshan med kyi ye shes mngon du gyur par byed/ mchan/ dkyil 'khor gyi rkyen/ snang ba yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi klong du 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ma btsal ye rdzogs chen por yongs su grub pa'o// sngon smon bsod nams bsags pa'i mthu las dad mos kyi rkyen no/ nges tshig ni/ a bhi ṣiñca'i sgra las drangs na gtor ba dang blugs pa ste/ sgo gsum gyi sgrib gnyis bag chags thams cad gtor ba dang*/ dbang don gyi ye shes yon tan 376)thams cad rgyud la 'jog pas na blugs pa'o/ dbye ba ni/ bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ tshig dbang ste/ bum dbang gis lus lha skur bsgom par smin// gsang dbang gis rlung dang rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i skal ba dang ldan// sher dbang gis gtum mo'i 'od gsal bsgom pa la dbang*/ tshig dbang gis ka dag rdzogs pa chen po'i don mngon du gyur nas*/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i go 'phang mngon du gyur par byed pa'o/ dbang thob pa'i phan yon ni/ skye ba du mar dbang gi sgo ru 'jug cing smin grol gyi snod du rung bar byed do/ ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ chos nyan pa dang brtson pa dang sgrub pa sogs ji ltar byas kyang dbang gi smin grol du ma 'jug pa'i rkyen gyis shes rgyud grol bar mi 'gyur bas bskyed rdzogs kyi nus pa zhan pa sogs 'byung ngo*/

shī la badz+ra'i ngor bde ba'i rdo rjes so// 377)lung rtogs chos kyi spyan mnga' mchog sprul don grub rdo rje la zhu yig tu phul ba blun gtam rig pa'i 'dra 'bag brjod pa ni/ bdag gis mkha' 'gro'i zab gnad kyi brda khrol shin tu dka' ba'i stobs kyis man ngag gi don rnams gsal po zhig zhu rngo ma gsal yang*/ rang gi rtogs pa'i 'dra 'bag log pa'i sgro btags cung zad zhu na/ gdod ma'i gnas lugs ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum gyi bdag nyid chen po de'i ngang las grol 'khrul gnyis kyi gzhi byed pa'i cha nas spyi gzhir brjod kyang grol 'khrul gyi chas dbye ba tsam ma gtogs gzhi dang gzhi snang gi ngo bo gcig pas na/ de lta bu'i gzhi'i rang bzhin gyi ngang las rig pa'i cha shin tu phra ba'i stobs kyis ye shes kyi rlung gis snying po bskyod de/ gzhi snang lhun grub kyi rol pa 'char tshul brgyad du shar ba la/ thugs rje'i rtsal las shes pa go ma 'gags par rang byung ba de/ kun tu bzang pos skad cig dang po nyid nas shes pa yul phyir ma 'chor bar rig par skyes te/ ye gzhi spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings kyi rang mdangs 378)lhun grub sku dang ye shes thams cad rang snang du shes pa'i stobs kyis gzhir gnas kyi rig pa'i gnas tshul dang yin lugs mthong phan chad/ gzhi rang gi chos nyid la rang gis mnyam par bzhag dang ma bzhag med par ye shes zang thal ba'i 'od gsal chen po'i ngang du gnas pas/ ye gdangs lhun grub kyi lam snang thams cad rang bzhin du rdzogs pas lam dang 'bras bu'i chos tha dad gsar du bsgrub pa gang yang dmigs su med pa'i cha la lam gyi tha snyad tsam dang*/ skad cig gnyis par rang ngor nas/ mchan/ 'bras chos nyer lnga'i dbang phyug gi dpal dang ldan cing sa lam rim par ltos ma dgos par mnyam gnas kyi ye shes chen po dus gsum kun tu 'pho 'gyur g.yo ba med pa/ spros bral 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings nyid 'khrul par mi gnas/

'khrul phyir mi 'brangs 'khrul du mi srid pa'i phyir bzang po ste/ mdor na gzhi rang gi chos nyid dam yon tan thams cad gcig char du rjogs pas/ 'bras bu'i chos drug la sogs pa brnyes nas mig 'phrul lta bur gdod ma'i sar grol bar bstan pa tsam gyi go ba las/ nang don gyi ye shes 'di dang 'di'o zhes thag chod pa 379)zhig bdag la thos bsam gyi gnas dben pas zhu rngo ma gsal lags/ rang dang mnyam pa'i thos shes med pa dag la 'di'i don go sla ba'i ched du rig ma rig gi bye brag tsam las gzhi la phyi nang med kyang yod tshul bstan nas/ gang zag gi rgyud kyi gnas lugs ji bzhin par ngo 'phrod pa'i cha la grol gzhi dang*/ snang ngor 'thas nas sems kyi cha tsam yang mi shes pa la 'khrul gzhi ste/ de'i bye brag brgyud ldan bla ma dam pa'i man ngag la brten nas gzhi skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba'i gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par mthong ba gzhi/ brtags dpyad goms 'dris kyi sgo nas rtogs pa mngon du ma gyur bar du le lo dang g.yeng ba med par lta spyod ya bral du ma song bar nyams su blangs nas bsgom pas/ gang gi gnyen por 'gro dgos na ma rig pa dang nyon mongs/ gang chod dgos na bdag rtog gnyis snang gi 'dzin pa/ gang grol dgos na rang gi shes rgyud grol dgos/ de ma grol na gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi spun thag yin pas/ de 'dul ba'i thabs rgyal ba'i bka'/ bla ma'i lung*/ rang gi rig pa tshad ma gsum gyi sgo nas gtan la phab 380)ste nyams len la sna mi sun par chos nyid zad par ma thon bar du sgo gsum chos min gyi bya ba spangs te gzhi ni gnas lugs mthar 'khyol ba zhig byed pa lam dang*/ de ltar tshul bzhin bsgoms pa'i mthar chos sku 'gyur ba med pa sku gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings yid dpyod du ma song bar mngon du gyur pa'i tshe na chu thig rgya mtshor 'dres tshe rgya mtsho dang dbye bsal med pa ltar/

lam gyi rig pa dang gzhi'i rig pa zhes tha dad med par nam mkha' nam mkhar thim pa ltar ye gzhi chos sku'i klong du ro gcig cing gnyis su med par brtan pa thob pa ni 'bras bu'i cha tsam brjod kyang*/ don la gdams ngag rang rang gi rgyud dang mthun pa'i sgo nas gnyis snang la 'char tshul mtho dman ci rigs par 'gro bas mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa dang*/ khyad par rang la phyi nang gi yon tan sna gcig med pa'i rkyen gyis bshad pa thams cad mgo med mjug med lta bu yin pas man ngag phug thug pa mi shes kyang nyid rin po che'i bka' ma bcag tsam du rmongs pa bdag gis chos nyid kyi bzhugs tshul blo dang yid dpyod kyis dpyad nas zhus pa yin pas thugs klong rin po cher mnga' thub zhu zhu/ ces kun bzang bde skyong chos nyid dbang mos bgyis pa'o// dge'o// 381)gdod nas rnam dag rig pa byang chub sems// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med 'od gsal klong*// sku dang ye shes yon tan lhun rdzogs dpal// gdod ma'i mgon po pad+ma las 'brel la// sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas gus phyag 'tshal// mi 'gyur bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du rol// e ma gson dang rdo rje'i mched po lags// shin tu zab gsang 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// man ngag kun gyi snying po mthar thug pa// 'bras bu mngon byed nges don sangs rgyas lam// ye grol spros bral rdzogs pa chen po'i don// gnad gsum 'dus pa'i khyad chos cung zhig smra// sems las ma byung rang rig sangs rgyas ni// sems dang sems byung 'khrul pa'i blo dang bral// ma rig sgrib pa'i mun pa dbyings su zhi// lhun grub sku dang ye shes yon tan rdzogs// don gnyis mthar phyin gzhon nu bum pa'i skur// 'bras bu gzhi thog phebs pa sangs rgyas gnad// lung las ma byung rang byung ye shes ni// brgyud ldan bla ma dam pa la brten nas// mos gus zab mos byin rlabs gzhir bzung ste// rang gsal dri med rig pa'i rang zhal mjal// spros pa'i tshig dang dpe la

382)ma ltos par// ngang gnas mngon gyur mthong ba man ngag gnad// rgyu las ma byung rang 'bras mngon byung ni// theg brgyad grub mtha'i skabs ltar tshogs gnyis kyi// 'jug sgo tha dad lam du mi ltos par// gzhi gnas rig pa gdod nas rnam par dag /lhun grub sku dang ye shes yon tan kun// mngon gyur ngang gnas chos sku'i rgyal sa ru// da lta nyid las grol ba 'bras bu'i gnad// de ltar rig dbyings mngon gyur dgongs pa'i babs// gces nor snying mig srog las phangs na yang*// las dang skal bar ldan pa'i bu la gdams// rtsol sgrub blos byas spros pa kun spongs la// snang ba'i yul gyur sprul sku'i ye shes rtsal// gsal ba ma 'gags longs sku'i ye shes ngang*// mi rtog bsam rjod bral ba chos sku'i gdangs// thams cad sku gsum mnyam pa nyid du rdzogs// bsal bzhag med par gdod ma'i zad sar phyin// 'di yis rten 'byung rmi lam bzhin du mthong*// zhen 'dzin 'khrul pa gdod ma'i gzhi la sangs// chos nyid don la the tshom dri ma bral// thams cad rig par rtogs pa'i gding thob nas// tshe 'dir gzhon nu bum skur grol bar nges/ sa ma ya/ 383) rgya rgya rgya/ zhes pa 'di yang rdo rje'i mched po bla ma kar don gyis rin chen dang po'i sku rten dang rin chen gnyis pa'i nang mchod sogs dang*/ lha reg dri bral kun dā'i mdangs 'dzin bcas bskul ngo mi ldog tsam du mdo med 'chol mo kun bzang chos nyid bde skyong dbang mos ser dgon dben khrod nas bris pa'o// dge'o// thun dung 'bud dus bsam rgyu yod pas dal mo byas nas 'bud dgos pa yin/ thun sdom dus nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi rtsa ba dug lnga dang dug gsum las med par rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi dug lnga'i sgrib pa dag pa'i phyir lan lnga 'bud/ dug gsum gyi rtsa ba gcod pa'i don ha sprugs gsum 'bud/

smon pa dang 'jug pa'i don bsgom nas rang gzhan gnyis ka sangs rgyas kyi sa la sgrol bar bsam la lan ma gnyis kyis zhog lags/ thun grol dus chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi rtsa ba sku lnga'am ye shes lnga ldan du tshang bas na lan lnga 'bud pas sems can thams cad kyi dug lnga dag nas ye shes lnga'am sku lnga thob par bsam/ ha sprugs gsum 'bud/ sku gsum mngon du gyur nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad tshe gcig lus gcig tu 384) chos sku rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par bsam la/ ha sprugs gsum gyi mjug tu lan ma gnyis 'bud/ rang gzhan gnyis ka sku gnyis zung 'jug thob nas don gnyis mthar phyin par bsam la/ khyon sdom thun dung shar ma bdun las med lags/ rgyal ba'i bka' min/ nga rang gi rdzun ris yin pas yin min gnyis ka yod thang*/ bde ba'i rdo rjes rang slob thub bstan bzang po la ban yag dben khrod nas bris pa'o/ dge'o// bai phug chos sgar la phrin yig bskur ba'i skabs don/ bdag gis man ngag rdzogs pa chen po'i gdams pa'i gnad rnams tshangs sprugs su byin yod pas/ der lhun grub rang snang du ngo shes par bya zhing rig pa ka dag la gding thob par mdzod dang*/ bla ma chos sku'i rgyal sa la thon los 'gro lags/ phran kyang da skabs nyon mongs lnga'i rdzong mkhar du kun brtags 'khrul pa'i dmag sgar chags nas nyon yid kyis nyin 'thab mtshan 'thab byed 'dug kyang*/ bla ma'i man ngag gis ngar blud nas gzung 'dzin rang grol gyi me btsa' de ma rig rgan mo'i mgo la bzhag nas 385)'od gsal mnyam brdal gyi mal sa ru bcos med bde lugs su nyal nas tshogs drug rang grol du yan pa'i skabs yin pas bde bar gnas/ bde ba'i rde rjes so// rtsang sgar bden khrod kyi rang slob dam pa rnams la spring yig tu gdams pa/ khyed bu slob mchog dman kun gyis mal sa bde mo'i nang nas sha mar thud sogs zas gang dga' la longs spyod cing tshab tshub kyis bla rnamare gsungs pa yus che mi mdzad par/

ka dag dang lhun grub kyi nyams len la rang rkya thub thabs re ma 'chugs rem rem/ yul snang gi 'gyur ba la nges pa med pa dgongs bzhin/ 'khrul snang 'khrul gzugs kyi snang ba thams cad rang la bden med sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du ston pa'i slob dpon yin pas/ de gar rig pa'i btsan sa zin pa dgos ma gtogs de tsam ma go na chos thams cad sgyu ma red/ rmi lam red/ rang snang yin zer ba thams cad ri mo'i rta glang lta bu'i phyogs su nges pas phyin chad bar do'i snang ba'ang de dang 'dra mtshungs pas chod dka' bar snang lags/ des na sngar khrid kyi skabs sogs dus kun tu bdag gis khyed rnams la zhus pa ltar rig pa ka 386)dag la gding thob par byed cing lhun grub rang snang du shes nas rtsal rdzogs dgos/ de ltar zung 'jug gis lam la brtan pa thob nas slar gding dang drod tshad rtogs pa thams cad mngon du gyur pa la/ mnyam rjes spyod lam rkyen bzang ngan sems bde sdug yid dga' skyo la sogs gang gi skabs su'ang lta ba'i stangs ma shor/ sgom pa'i gding dang ma bral/ spyod pa bag med du skad cig tsam yang mi btang bar rang gi rig pa'i chos nyid la goms 'dris byed cing*/ chos can chos nyid du grol ba'i tshad la gtug dgos zhes zhus bzhin mchog dman kun gyis nyams len gyi mtha' bskyangs nas sgo gsum chos min gyis bya ba rgyang nas spangs te/ thugs mthun khrims gtsang gi sgo nas zhag brgya mthar phyin gyi dgongs spyod mi chung bar zhu/ zhes pa yos zla 12tshes 17la ri che'i zhabs drung gi gser khang shar gyi nyi mthongs nas bde ba'i rdo rjes phul/ dge'o// rgyal kun 'dus zhal mtsho skyes rje// dbyer med dpal ldan bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs// bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ka ye gson dang rigs ldan/ kha dog 387)med pa'i sems nyid// ga ler gtan la phobs dang*// nga bdag brdzun phug stong 'gro// ca co'i tshig tsam shes kyang*// cha mthun nyams len med na// ja sogs 'dod yon// nya mo gser mig ldan yang*// ta thā ga ta'i bstan chos// tha mal gnas su gol 'gro// da nas byang chub bar du// na mo dad pa'i gtsug rgyan// pa ra mi ta'i snying bcud// pha nor bzhin du bsten mdzod// ba gam lta bu'i go sa// ma rabs spyod dang ma bsre// tsa zan cang shes rta mchog

/tsha grang bde sdug go bzhin// dza grogs 'khor 'bangs mnga' ris// wa ler byams brtses bskyangs te// zhwa dmar bstan pa'i rgyan du// za 'og mdzes ldan dpe bzhin// 'a 'ur rol mo'i dbyangs snyan// ya rabs spyod pa'i rjes bstun// ra me shwa ra'i gnas bdag /la 'ur ma 'gyang gsol na// sha za srin po'i 'phrul zhi// sa thob sems dpa'i dpal nor// ha lo'i 'bras bzhin smin nges// a la ku re yin no// bden min rdzun min tshig 'di// su kha'i ming gis bris so// 388)a ho/ ka dag rig pa smra bsam brjod pa bral/ kha dog ma nges lhun grub yon tan rdzogs// ga ler ma bcos rang babs ngang skyongs dang*// ngar 'dzin 'khrul pa gnyis med dbyings su grol// chos can mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i chos rnams kyang*// chos nyid spros mtha' bral ba'i ngang du dag /gang snang gang shar ye shes chen po'i rtsal// ye grol blo 'das chos sku'i dgongs par mnyam// de la dbye bsal spang blang byar med pas// mngon gyur ngang gnas gtan srid zin par mdzod// de ltar 'khrul med gnas lugs chen po'i don// skyes dman bdag 'dras brjod pa'i gnas min kyang*// slob bu'i thugs bzhed skong phyir zur tsam zhu// dpe ru ma bzhag gnad don nyams len rem/ zhes bde ba'i rdo rjes gang dran yig ris su bris pa'o// dge'o//

389) sems med sprang mo'i rmongs glu bzhugs/ yid kyi 'khri shing dpa' bo// cha med yul la byon thal// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis// mthun mkhyen lam grogs mdzod cig /sems med bde ba'i rdo rje// grogs med shul la lus 'dug /bza' ba zas kyis ci byed// mgrin pa rlung gis gang song*// btung ba ja chang dgos med// sems med bem po stong song*// g.yog 'khor nor gyis ci byed// snying rlung stong du 'tshangs 'dug /lha rje brgya yis mi phan// yid kyi 'khri shing dran byung*// snying dang 'dra ba'i dpa' bo// da tsam gang du byon yod// sems med bde ba'i rdo rje// grogs med shul la yi mug /brtse bas bskyangs pa dran dus// mig nas mchi ma thar thar// sdug bsngal mun nag thib thib// don snying med pa'i mi bzhin// gtad med had por song 'dug /lha lam yangs pa'i mkha' nas// bya rgyal 'phur lding g.yo ba// gsal byed sgo ru mngon dus// thang dkar rgod las skyid zhig /sa steng 'di na mi 'dug /nga yi snying grogs dam pa// gar bzhugs gar byon los rig /'bral med 'grogs na chog 390) gam// go min gnas min yul nas// sems med bde ba'i rdo rjes// yi mug glu ru drangs nas// sdug rgur mi byed ka med// bgrod pa'i nus pa med do// ha ha bde ba'i rdo rjes// rang sems gtan la phabs 'dug /'khrul snang dngos por ma 'dzin// rig pa mi 'gyur rdo rje// stong dbyings shes rab btsun mo// gdangs snang ma 'gags dpa' bo// dbyer med mnyam nyid ro gcig /'du 'bral yul las 'das song*// ye gzhi gdod ma'i mkha' la// 'dzin bral thang dkar rgod pos// 'khrul snang dbyings su bshig nas// rig pa mi 'gyur brag la// rang sa zin pa e ma// snang stong bde ba chen po'i// zag med bcud la rol dang*// don gyi dpa' bo mchog yin// rig stong dbyer med 'od gsal// 'da' med gtan srid zin 'ong*/

ces pa'ang yid bzhin nor bu byon nas nga rang shul du lhag pas rkyen byas te nyer brgyad kyi nyin thun bar zhig la 'chol gtam yig ris su bris pa'o// dge'o// sku gsum rigs 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// dbyer med rig 'dzin 'jigs bral chos kyi dbang*// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud 391)byin gyis rlobs// e ma gson dang lha grogs dam pa rnams// 'jig rten 'khor ba'i las la snying po med// snying po yod pa dam pa'i lha chos yin// tshe gcig sgrub la gzhol zhig mched grogs rnams// o rgyan dngos sprul 'jigs bral chos kyi dbang*// 'bral med nyin mtshan dus drug gsol ba thobs// ye shes rang zhal mjal 'ong mched grogs rnams// nga dang mi thug bsam nas yid ma skyo// nga dang nam yang 'bral bdag la yod// skye med spros bral ma bcos khyab brdal klong*// ye stong kun bzang dbang mo nga nyid ni// bsam brjod bral ba'i ngang nas rang zhal mjal// ma 'gags rang byung lhun grub rol rtsal las// rig stong bde ba'i rdo rje nga nyid ni// stong gsal 'gags med klong nas rang zhal mjal// thugs rje'i rtsal snang sgyur ma'i cho 'phrul las// mtha' bral bde sbyong dbang mo nga nyid ni// chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang du mjal// gzhi snang lhun grub bde chen 'dus ma byas// lam snang mkha' spyod dbang mo nga nyid dang*// gnyis med ye rdzogs chen po'i rang zhal mjal// namayang 'bral ba med do mched grogs rnams// chos 392) med dge med bde ba'i rdo rje nga*// mi tshe'i lhag ma chos la dril snying 'dod// tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam na zhe blo bde// nor med zas med bde ba'i rdo rje nga*// blo phug sprang gtad dka' spyad byed snying 'dod// mi thabs lha thabs med kyang zhe blo bde// cha med rgyus med bde ba'i rdo rje nga*// nges med dben rir sgrub tshugs zin na snyam// bya spyod blo mang zer yang zhe blo bde// cha med rgyus med bde ba'i rdo rje nga*// nges med dben rir sgrub tshugs zin na snyam// bya spyod blo mang zer yang zhe blo bde// go min gnas min bde ba'i rdo rje nga*// gcig pur bag yangs bsam gtan bsgom snying 'dod// gnas sa ma chod zer yang zhe blo bde// pad+ma'i rgyal tshab thabs grogs yin snyam rung*// rang nyid bsod nams dman pas 'thab grogs gyur// 'thab 'khon tshe rogs ngan pas dgos pa chung*// snang cha bde chen dpa' bo yab dang 'grogs// grogs med gcig pu zer yang zhe blo bde*// skyabs kyi pha med mgon gyi ma yang med// mdza' ba'i gros med bde ba'i rdo rje nga*// yid kyi 'khri shing dpa' bo rgud du bcug

/bde chen pad+ma 'od du 'gro snying 'dod// pha ming btsan po med kyang zhe blo bde// a cang ku re yin no mched grogs rnams// skyid skyod bu mo nga las skyid pa med// mi yi ngo bsrung mdun ma g.yog la sogs// gcig kyang mi dgos rang mgo 393) thon na chog /rang gzhan don gnyis gdan thog 'di ru 'grub// sdug sdug bu mo nga las sdug pa med// tshe rogs grar langs mi 'dod sna 'dren byed// sna tshogs thabs kyis dbang med yul gzhan spyugs// bgrod pa'i rkang med zhwa grum gom par song*// dwa phrug ming sring khas nyam chung ba yis// pha yi nor skal bcad nas bka' bkyon che// sha tsha yi mug snying rlung stod la 'tshubs// nged cag ma bu'i sdug bsngal su yis bzod// gces pa'i srog dang mtshungs pa'i ming sring gnyis// cha med yul du rgyus med khyi bzhin 'khyams// snying med a pha shul la zhe re khrel// 'dir snang sgyu ma rmi lam yin yang thang*// phyi ma las 'bras bslu med 'o re brgyal// brtse ldan mched grogs rnams kyi snyan drung du// bde ba'i rdo rjes skyo gtam yi ger phul// 'u cag mi 'gyangs dngos mjal smon lam zhu/ zhes pa 'di yang rig 'dzin chen po 'jigs bral chos kyi blo gros kyis dngos slob dam pa rnams kyi ngag gsal spyi bor son tshe bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes yi mug gang dran glu ru drangs pa'o// dge'o// 394) phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas 'dus pa'i dpal// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag 'gro mgon pad+ma 'byung*// shes rab phul phyin ma gcig mtsho rgyal la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// snying med bde ba'i rdo rje tshur nyon dang*/ khyod 'dra'i las ngan lus dman su zhig yod// mo lo bco lnga nas bzung sum cu'i bar// mi yi mdun ma g.yog sogs chos brgyad bskyangs// ngal ba don med mi tshe sdug la gzad// rang sems rtse mo 'khor ba'i bya bar phyogs// col chung g.yeng ba che zhing tshugs mi thub// che 'dod grags 'dod dgra gnyen nyer len zhib// log lam chos 'gal dmyal ba'i gting rdo byed// thar pa phar zhog 'phral bde tsam yang med// mi rtag 'chi ba snying nas mi sems par// chos la phyi bshol gzod bya long yod bsam// 'chi ba thon dus stong log yi re mug

/gang la dbang yod de la ser sna yod// rang gzhan bdag bzung mi dge'i las ngan bsags// ser sna'i mdud pa ma khrol gtong phod chung*// su dang 'grogs kyang 'thab 'khor rtsod pa'i gzhi// dug lnga me 'bar rang rgyud rwa ltar gyong*// dad mos chung zhing thos bsam sgom pa 395)zhan// bskyed rdzogs gnad don mi shes kha pho mtho// gnyis 'dzin mdud rgya ma grol pho tshod che// snang srid sems su mi shes ras chod byed// rang sems rang gis mi non khong khro gsog /bya bral bsam nas 'khor chen res mos 'dzin// gcig pur zer nas bu brgyud 'tsho skyong byed// chog shes dgos zer khe tshong rgyun mi bcad// bla ma bsten zer sdom bslab dam mi bsrung*// mched grogs yin zer rgyud dkrugs dma' phab byed// mtshams sgrub yin zer tshogs ngan 'khor lo bskor// yon tan kun zad skyon kun lus la tshang*/ khyod 'dra'i las ngan 'di 'dra mthong tsam na// ye shes spyan ldan rnams kyang thugs khrel nas// 'jig 'das srung mas bka' yi chad pa yong*// kyi hud kyi hud las ngan snying stobs can// da ni la 'ur dam pa'i chos la brtson// chags sdang dug gi me tog bskyur la thongs// bsam pa gtan phobs ma ṇi yig drug thon// gnyis 'dzin 'khor ba'i brtod phur phud la thongs// bsam pa gtan phobs= gsog 'jog ser sna'i mdud pa khrol la zhog /bsam pa gtan= tshong khe mi dge'i 396) las sna bskyur la thongs// bsam pa gtan= gzhan sems dkrugs pa'i tshig ngan mi smra zhing*// rang skyon ngos bzung gnyen po dran shes bsten// bsam pa= col chung snang ba ma mtho man sa zungs// mi tshe'i lhag ma blo phug chos la gtod// bsam pa= gnod sems tshogs ngan 'khor los dgos pa chung*// phan sems byang chub sems la blo sbyang nas// bsam pa= da ni ci byas chos dang bstun gal che// 'phral bde gtan bde ma brje snying med ma/

khyod 'dra'i las ngan sems can gcig kyang med// da dung kha pho snang ba ri bas mtho// tshe rabs mang por las ngan bsags pa'i 'bras// da res lus la na tsha rgyun chad med// sems la sdug bsngal mi 'dod sna tshogs 'byung*// skyid sdug bya ba rang la rag las pas// bsam pa= mtshan ldan bla mar mnyes gsum zhabs tog sgrubs// gdams ngag chud zos ma btang nyams len rem// bya spyod blo sna ma ring rang tshugs zungs// grogs la mthun 'khon ma byed dge ba 'bungs// bsam pa= rang mgo ma thon gshin po'i dom ma khur// chos brgyad bya bas dgos med dam chos sgrubs/ 397)/bsam pa gtan phobs ma ṇi yig drug thon// de skad chos med mdo shor tha shal ba// sprang mo kalpa bha dra tā re yis// rang skyon dran pa'i lcags kyus snar drangs nas// rang la gdams pa tshig snyan med mod kyang*// rang gi blun tshig sems la phan phyir dang*// rang la yon tan med pa'i gzhi mthong nas// bde ba'i rdo rjes rang gi rang la smras/ ha ha/ blos byas byis pa'i chos la ya mi nga*// gang shar shar chug gang yin yin du chug /spang blang gnyen po mi tshol chos nyid rgyan// zab zab 'dod lugs grub mthas ci zhig bya// rang sems mi non chags sdang 'phel ba'i gzhi// gcig shes kun grol rig pa byang chub sems// ye grol blo bral 'dus ma byas pa'i chos// mi 'gyur rdo rje bdun ldan ye sangs rgyas// chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba de bzhin nyid// snying po don dam rang byung rig par rdzogs// brdal khyab klong chen dgongs pa'i btsan sa zin// sgyu ma'i 'phrul la ya nga bag tsha med// sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor su kha badz+ra gyis// sgyu ma'i rtsal snang yi ge'i ris su bris// su mi 'thad 398) kyang rang nyid zhe blo bde// 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul e ma ho/ ces sprang smyon 'du shes gsum pas rang la smras pa dge dge'o// ha ha/ bsgrubs nas 'grub pa sangs rgyas ngas ma mjal// blo 'das gnyug ma rang gdangs ma thob na/

khung phug byi ba nyal 'dras sangs mi rgya// gu yangs btang bzhag med pa'i ngang du bzhag /bzlas brjod chos nyid rang sgrar ma rtogs na// lan med lkugs pa lta bus sangs mi rgya// gang shar smra brjod spang blang med par bzhag /bla ma'i man ngag dgongs pa ma lon na// zab zab man ngag mang po'i don mi go /go yul tsam gyis ye shes ngo mi mthong*// spyod lam gang shar mnyam rjes dbyer med par// man ngag 'od gsal gsang lam ji bzhin bzhag /bskyed rdzogs bzlas brjod thun bcad thugs dam sogs// mtshan mar 'dzin pa rnam rtog 'phel ba'i rgyu// rnam rtog spangs nas sprang mo nyal snying 'dod// zhen bral yangs pa'i thang la mal sa bde// 'dzin med rang gsal mtha' bral gdan khri rdzogs// gang shar rang grol shugs 'byung bag yangs ngang*// kun bzang 399)lhun grub bde skyong dbang mo nga*// ye grol spang thob bral ba'i klong du nyal// 'bras bu phyi dus mi re rang thog grol// ka dag chos sku'i ngang du e ma ho// chos med sprang mos nyal nyams glu ru blangs// yid rten thabs mchog dpa' bo'i snyan du gsol// nor 'khrul song na chos dbyings klong du bshags// bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes rang la gdams// nyal gros gdams pas 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog dge'o// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur mtsho rgyal ma// mi 'bral spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lor bzhugs// bdag rgyud chos dang 'dres par byin gyis rlobs// rang yul srin gling 'dra ste spangs nas su// nges med gnas su tshe gcig sgrub la brtson// snying po phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la snyegs// lta ba ka dag rtsa bral blo las 'das// sgom pa ma bcos 'dzin zhen yul las grol// spyod pa gang shar sbrul mdud ji bzhin du// re dogs mtshan ma las 'das rang grol ngang*/ gzhi rig gsal stong nam mkha' gsum dang ldan// sku gsum rang rig klong rdzogs e ma ho// lam snang khyad

400) chos drug ldan ye gdangs che// dbyings rig kun bzang dgongs pa e ma ho// 'bras bu gzhon nu bum pa'i sku mchog brnyes// ye gzhi ye grol ka dag e ma ho// rol rtsal 'khor 'das chos kun rgyan du shar// snang srid dgra ru ldang yang re dogs med// rang rig kun tu bzang po e ma ho// 'bras bu phyi dus mi re rang thag chod// chos med sprang mo su kha badz+ra gyis// 'khrul gtam 'khrul tshig yi ge'i ris su bris// kun tu bzang dang dbyer med pa// 'dren mchog pad+ma las 'brel la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzod// ka dag rig pa chos kyi sku/ kha dog rang gsal longs spyod rdzogs// kun rig kun gsal sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum mnyam nyid gzhi la rdzogs// thob bya'i 'bras bur nga mi re// rang byung rig pa bcos med 'di// kun bzang dgongs pa e ma ho/ su kha badz+ra gyis so// ka dag chos sku'i dgongs pa// blos byas yul las 'das song*/ kha dog cir yang ma grub// 'dzin med 'od gsal rig pa// ga 401)ler mnyam bzhag skyongs dang*// nga bdag rtsa ba chod nas// gnyug ma'i rang zhal mjal yong*/ zhes pa'ang rdzun rkyal sprang mos bris pa dge bar gyur cig he he/ dred po bde ba'i rdo rjes// sems rgod srab kha ma thub// le lo'i dmag la rgyugs nas// thos bsam mkha' la yal song*// snang zhen dar gyi mdud pa// lhod med rgya yis btab nas// 'dod chags sbra khang nang na// sazhe sdang gnas mal bde bde// nga rgyal gdan khri'i steng na// phrag dog gos bzang gyon nas// gti mug ro nyal byed cing*// dug lnga rang gar spyod pa// bde ba'i rdo rje los yin// thos bsam sgom pa'i brtson 'grus/ khyod la yod pa ma mthong*// bu dang bu mo'i brtson 'grus/ khyod la yod pa los bden// dgos med rgyud la skyes na/ khyod kyi bya bral los yong*// 'khor chen 'khor chung 'dor len// bya bral mi yong thag chod// nges 'byung dad pa zab zib/

khyod la yod pa los bden// bla ma'i man ngag zab bcud// nyams su ma lon tha chad// lta ba nam mkha' mdung bskor/ 402) khyod kyi shes pa bden na// dug lnga'i dmag dang 'phrad dus// tha mal ba dang khyad med// g.yul ngo'i bu chung los bden// go min gnas min sa mtha'// mi min nor min bu mo// bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes// gter min gter 'dra'i sgo phyes// theg min theg chen rloms nas// ci min chal chol smras 'dug /yul ngan mgo log yul na// skye ngan bde ba'i rdo rje// bsam ngan bdud kyi dbang gis// grogs ngan rkyen gyis bskul nas// tshogs ngan 'khor lo'i rgyun bzung*// 'thab 'khon bya ba byed cing*// 'gro don yin pa los bden// lus ngan bde ba'i rdo rje// las ngan bya ba ma mang*// bsam ngan gdug sems spongs la// rwa 'dra'i rang rgyud gtan phobs// zab bcud nyams su len dgos// mtshan ldan grogs dang 'phrad dus// mnyes gsum zhabs tog bsgrub dgos// rang snang dgra ru langs dus// rkyen snang rang sar grol dgos// rang rgyud dug gi sgye 'dra// gzhan la chos bshad ma byed// mi min rang snang ston pas// smin grol lam mchog bstsal dus// rang skal nyams su longs la// le lo'i dbang du ma bskyur// grogs ngan 403)rkyen gyis bskul tshe// bzod pa'i go cha brtan dgos// 'khor dang 'thab 'khon ma byed// rang kha zungs la nyol sdod// bskyed rdzogs sna gcig med pa'i// gzhan gnod khong khro bskyur thengs// rang rgyud chos dang mi mthun// gzhan don mi yong nyol sdod// de ltar sems la zungs dang*/ khyod la go rgyu yod do// skyon tshang yon tan kun zad// sprang mo bde ba'i ming gis// rang la gdams pa e go /ha ha he he ho ho// bris ngan bde ba'i rdo rjes// shog ngan shog mtha'i ngos la// tshig ngan rang skyon sna tshogs// snag ngan sol khus bris yod// slob ngan thub bstan bzang po/

kha ngan khol mo rdeb rdeb// ma byed rang kha zungs sdod// nga la yon tan med pas// rang skyon yod pa los go /nga rang lta bu'i las ngan// gcig kyang yod pa ma mthong*// skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyis// bdag gi blo sna bsgyur mdzod/ ces pa'ang yul mi rnams kyis dred po zer ba la yid tshim nas rang skyon zur tsam bris pa'o// ha ha/ ka dag rig pa smra bsam brjod pa bral/ kha dog ma nges lhun grub 404)yon tan rdzogs// ga ler ma bcos rang babs ngang skyongs dang*// ngar 'dzin 'khrul pa gnyis med dbyings su grol// chos can mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i chos rnams kyang*// chos nyid spros mtha' bral ba'i ngang du dag /gang snang gang shar ye shes chen po'i rtsal// ye grol blo 'das chos sku'i dgongs par mnyam// de la dbye bsal spang blang byar med pas// mngon gyur ngang gnas gtan srid zin par mdzod// de ltar 'khrul med gnas lugs chen po'i don// skye dman bdag 'dras brjod pa'i gnas min kyang*// slob bu'i thugs bzhed skong phyir zur tsam zhu// dpe ru ma bzhag gnad don nyams len rem/ ces bde ba'i rdo rjes gang dran yig ris su bris pa'o// dge'o// chos dbyings khyab brdal mnyam par rol pa las// 'gro ba'i don du sgyu ma'i skur snang ba// he ru ka dpal pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// rdo rje btsun mo bde chen bde ba'i dbang*// reg pa mnyam sbyor lha sku'i phyag rgyar bzhengs// dran rdzogs ma hā yo gar lhun gyis grub// snang dbyings thabs mchog dpa' bo he ru ka /ye stong shes rab mchog gyur bde chen 405)dkar// dga' bzhi stong bzhi'i 'od gsal klong du sbyor// gdos bcas zag zad zag med 'od skur grol// don dam a nu yo gar lhun gyis grub// rig pa bde chen ye shes ro ma dkar// stong pa gsal ba'i ye shes rkyang ma dmar// rang byung rlung gi ye shes rlabs g.yos pas// kun 'dar dbu ma'i dbyings su gnyis med sbyar// gdod nas sangs rgyas ye grol rang gnad mthong*// gnyis med a ti yo gar lhun gyis grub// chags med chags lam ltar snang rten 'brel tsam// dbyings dang ye shes mnyam sbyor gzung 'dzin bral// nyon mongs kun tu rtog pa dbyings su bcom// rgyu 'bras sa lam rim par mi ltos bar// bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa rnyed nas// nang gsal gzhon nu bum sku mngon du gyur// don gyi rta phag yab yum e ma ho// snying gi bcud 'dra'i gsang khrid zab mo 'di// snying gi bu la sba gsang med par spel// snying gi dkyil zung gsang bar nyams su longs// snying bcud zab mo yal bar ma dor bar// bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs kyis thub par srungs/

sa ma ya/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgya yod do/ ces pa'ang sngags kyi rnal 'byor du 'bod pa kun 406)bzang bde skyong dbang mos nyams len zur tsam snying gi bu la gdams pa'o// dge'o// sngon bsags las 'phro dag pa'i smon lam mthus// shel dkar mtsho dang kun dga' di paṃ sogs// zab gter bdag po'i skye srid mang du blangs// thabs grogs chos bdag rten 'brel legs 'grigs nas// 'gro don mthar phyin grub brnyes dngos grub thob// da ltar yul ngan mgo log phyogs su 'phen// log lam chos 'gal grogs dang bu slob 'phrad// log lta'i gnas mthong mi 'dod char rgyun phab/ kha nas dad gus mos pa lhang lhang byed// lkog tu 'bar gshe sma phab brnyas dmod rtsom// bsam ngan dug gi me tog zhe re khrel// mkha' 'gro lung bstan 'gro don zhing sa dang*// thabs grogs chos bdag zab gter chos skor sogs// tshul bzhin spyod pa'i gnad byang yod na yang*// ban nag bdud kyi grong nas bar chad rtsom// dam sel rkyen gyis rten 'brel du ma 'chug /gter bcud byin rlabs mkha' 'gro'i gling du drangs// thun mong las phran tsam las cher ma 'byung*// mga' ra ban nag zhing sa rnyog pa'i yul// ye shes spyan ldan rnams kyis mi gzigs 407) sam// bdag gis sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i mthu rtsal can// bka' srung myur mgyogs rnams kyis grogs re ran// dam nyams dgra bo'i srog rtsa dmar po mi bcad dam// bka' yi chad pa drag po mi gtong ngam// rtags mtshan gsal po da lta nyid du ston// za skal yin pas ma 'gyang phrin las mdzod// dam nyams 'di rnams brten dang 'grogs pa dang*// zab gnad 'byin dang gter chos spel ba sogs// mi bgyid dam bca' snying gi dkyil du bzung*// 'on kyang shel dkar smon lam 'phro ldan pas// nam mkha'i snying po bi ma mi tra yi// thugs sprul rnal 'byor gsang sngags gling pa yis// rjes bzung zab dgu'i gdams pa'i pha phog bstsal// blo bcos dpyad sgom tsam la gding mi bca'// rang gsal ye shes 'du 'bral med par 'char// stong chen rig pa'i dbyings la rang sa zin// du ma ro gcig dag mnyam chen por grol// rang byung rig pa kun bzang rang zhal mjal// 'bras bu phyi dus mi re gtan srid zin// de skad smyon ma mdo med gter brdzun mkhan// 'khrul zhig bde chen bde ba'i rdo rje yis// nai gro gsang phug rdo rje rdzong nas bris/

yi ge 408)pa ni snang sems rang grol lo// dge'o// rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa'i// las 'brel rtsal la gus pas 'dud// byang chub bar du bdag skyong la// 'bral med bde chen 'khor lor bzhugs// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// zur 'jug thabs grol zab mo'i lam// sngags kyi khyad chos gsang chen snying*// rnal 'byor ldan pa'i dpal gyur kyang*// tshul bzhin spyod pa dkon par mthong*// 'on kyang dus 'dir sngon smon mthus// rnal 'byor dpa' bo khyed dang 'phrad// myur lam rtogs brjod man ngag dang*// sa lam gcig rdzogs tshul rnams kun// dngos dang yi ge'i lam nas gsungs// des mthus skyes dman kho mo bdag /snying nas yi rang ngo mtshar che// da dung gsang spyod myur lam gnad/ khyod thugs 'od gsal sgrom nas phyungs// sba gsang gcus dkrugs mi mdzad par/ bdag gi dpal du bka' drin stsol// bdag kyang lus dman rkyen dbang gis// shes rab gsum gyi nor chung bas// bshad bya gzhung don cher dben kyang*// rang re'i lta spyod lam mthun pa'i// rang gi gsang spyod cung zhig zhu// lus dbang rnam par dag pa'i gzhi/ 409)/yan lag zhing gi bkod pa rdzogs// rtsa gsum 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su// rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub// rtsa gnas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i grong*// bde ba chen po'i gar du rol// snang ba yab la stong pa yum// bde chen pad+ma 'khor 'das gzhi// mchog gi bde bskyed ghan+dhe yi// rkyen bskul nye rgyu'i lam sbyor bas// dpa' bo'i rgya bslang sems sprin g.yos// 'od kyis mkha' khyab zhing kun gyi// rgyal mchod byin rlabs nus pa bsdus// dwangs ma'i thig ler ro gcig bcings// tshogs chen ye rdzogs ngang gis rdzogs// slar yang sems sprin gnas lngar khyab// lus dkyil skye mched lha rnams kun// bde chen zag med re yis mnyes// dga' mchog khyad lhan dga' bral gyi// gzhir drangs ye shes mngon gyur pa// mi slob lam mthar son pa yi// lam rnams kun gyi 'bras rdzogs pa// yas brtan thabs kyi dga' bar brdzod// rlung shes dmigs pa'i gnad gcun nas// sems sprin ldog khyab bcing ba yis// dga' ba dang ni mchog dga' dang*/

khyad par dga' dang lhan dga' yi// ye shes bzhi yi ngang 410)brtan pa// mas brtan shes rab dga' bar brjod// thabs shes dga' bde'i stobs shugs kyis// dus sbyor bcu gnyis gnas stongs nas// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mchog nyid// don gyis thob pa lam 'di'i khyad// mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba che// rnam kun mchog ldan don gyi dbyings// lha dang snang ba chos nyid gsum// dbyer med chen po mngon gyur pas// phyi nang gzhan gsum chos khams kun// ye nas ye shes lha yi ngang*// rdo rje gsum du dag smin rdzogs// mthar phyin thabs shes dbyer med par// rig sku mngon du gyur pa'i thabs// lam gyi lam mchog de ka'o// he he bde ster dpa' bo'i bde ba'i rgyus bskul nas// bde skyong dbang mo'i bde chen thabs kyi gnad// bde stong snyoms 'jug lam gyi khyad chos 'di// bde ba'i 'byung gnas dpa' bo khyed drung phul// bde skyed ḍā kis brtse bas rjes bzung nas// zung 'jug lam gyi pho nyar bdag 'gyur shog /de'i mthus mchog khyed sku tshe rab brtan nas// zab gter bstan pa mtha' du rgyas pa dang*// bstan 'gro'i bde skyid snang ba gong 'phel nas// pad 'byung yab yum thugs bzhed 411)bsgrub nus shog /de ltar bka' lung kun la mi gsal ba'i// rang lugs nyon mongs rang gar spyod pa'i lam// grogs kyi gsung gi dbugs dbyung phebs pa'i ngor// a mtshar mtshar gtam nyams ris yi ge ru// bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes bris te phul/ dge 'dis thabs shes dbyer med lhan 'dzom nas/ kha sbyor bdun ldan zung 'jug sku thob shog dge'o// snying las rab brtse dpa' bo mchog khyed gson// snying rje'i yul gyur kho mo bdag nyid la// sgo gsum yon tan spu tsam ma mchis kyang*/ khyed thugs dag pa'i snang ngor gsal ba yi// ku kur seng ge'i ming gi sgrar 'bod pa// gzhan gyis mthong tshe yid khrel smad gzhir mngon// 'on kyang tshe sngon smon lam 'phro ldan pas// tshe mjug mthun pa'i grogs bzang khyed dang 'phrad/

/zung 'jug lam gyi pho nyar bdag gyur mthus// bogs 'byin brtan pa gsum du bcings pa yis// 'khor lo lnga po'i mdud pa rab grol nas// nang don ye shes rtogs pa mngon gyur cing*// thabs shes dbyer med rig sku 'grub pa dang*// tshe 412)rabs kun tu 'bral med lhan 'dzom shog /e ma ku re yin no snying gi grogs/ kho mo'i gnas tshul zur tsam zhu ba phul// chung nas chos la mos pa rab thob pas// lo lnga lon dus chos kyi bsam pa skyes// lo bdun nas bzung mkha' 'gros rjes bzung nas// thun mong dang ni thun min chos rnams thob// bcu gnyis lo la sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas// stong rang gsum gyi lam la rab tu sbyangs// 'khor lo bzhi pa'i man ngag rim bzhin thob// bcu gsum lon tshe bla med nang rgyud kyi// 'khor lo lnga pa'i man ngag gcig brgyud du// thob 'bras rtsa rlung thig le cung smin nas// thog ma'i gter gyi kha byang phran bu rnyed// rmi lam 'khrul ngor mkha' 'gros rjes bzung nas// 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur du ma lung bstan mthus// bco lnga lon dus phyogs med phyogs 'dir 'khyams// bcu drug lon dus sngon 'brel chos dang 'phrad// bcu dgu'i lo nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin du// ming dang don mtshungs mgo log yul du bgrod// sngon las bzang dang 'phral rkyen gnyis 'dzom mthus// yun ring bar du 'khor ba'i chos kyis gos// 'phral 'phral gter dang gter grogs dang 'phrad 413)kyang*// gzhan rkyen ngo bsrung phyir du sab+tas bsgribs// rtsa dgu nas bzung rang gter dang 'phrad cing*// grogs dang chos 'dzin smon lam skal ldan nas// re zhig bar du bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgyas// sum cu rtsa gsum lo nas rkyen ngan ldangs// mgon dang skyabs bral gcig pur nges med du// seng ge yul bgrod bzhin du nyul zhing 'khyams// bde sdug ngal ba chu yi ris bzhin byung*// 'on kyang pad 'byung yab yum thugs rje dang*// skyabs gnas gter chen yab sras byin rlabs kyis// bstan 'gro'i phan bde phyogs tsam 'byung
